name: caddy-docker-proxy
description_en: Caddy as a reverse proxy for Docker
readme_excerpt: Caddy-Docker-Proxy Introduction This plugin enables Caddy to be used as a reverse proxy for Docker containers via labels. How does it work? The plugin scans Docker metadata, looking for labels indicating that the service or container should be served by Caddy. Then, it generates an in-memory Caddyfile with site entries and proxies pointing to each Docker service by their DNS name or container IP.
